title: Reefer Cargo Services: pre-trip inspection fees and how long an inspection stays valid
content:
## Scope

This clause of **Reefer Cargo Services** governs the pre-trip inspection (PTI) of the reefer unit allocated to a service: what each inspection costs, how long it covers plug-in at the load terminal, and when a repeat inspection is needed.

## Rule

1. Every reefer is inspected before use, and each inspection is charged: the first inspection at the tier's PTI fee and any repeat inspection at the tier's repeat PTI fee.
2. When the allocated reefer passes its pre-trip inspection at the depot, the service moves from requested to PTI passed. An inspection may be charged only while the service is PTI passed.
3. An inspection is valid for plug-in only until the tier's validity days after the inspection was charged. The validity ends on the date of the **latest** inspection charge plus the tier's validity days, counted on calendar dates, and a plug-in on that last day is covered.
4. A reefer not plugged in by the end of the validity is inspected again before plug-in, at the repeat fee.
5. The dates used are those of the inspection charges on the company's ledger for that service.

## Fee and validity table

| Tier | PTI fee (first inspection) | Repeat PTI fee | Validity after the inspection charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 75.00 USD | 60.00 USD | 30 calendar days |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 85.00 USD | 70.00 USD | 30 calendar days |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 95.00 USD | 80.00 USD | 14 calendar days |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 110.00 USD | 95.00 USD | 14 calendar days |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 150.00 USD | 130.00 USD | 7 calendar days |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 180.00 USD | 160.00 USD | 14 calendar days |

## Validity check: input, judgement, output

- **Input:** the date of the latest inspection charge on the service, the tier, and the plug-in date.
- **Judgement:** add the tier's validity days to the inspection charge date on the calendar to find the last covered day; compare the plug-in date with it.
- **Output:** plug-in on or before the last covered day is covered by that inspection; plug-in after it requires a repeat inspection, charged at the repeat fee, before plug-in.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

> **AHL Reefer Cold Treatment**, inspection charged on 1 June. The last covered day is 15 June.
> - Plug-in on 15 June: covered, no further inspection.
> - Plug-in planned for 16 June: the inspection has lapsed; the reefer is inspected again before plug-in and the repeat inspection is charged at 80.00 USD.
> - If that repeat inspection is charged on 16 June, it is now the latest inspection charge, and the new last covered day is 30 June.

> **AHL Reefer Pharma GDP**, inspection charged on 10 March. The last covered day is 17 March; plug-in on 17 March is covered, plug-in on 18 March is not.

## Basis Q&A

**Which inspection starts the validity after a repeat inspection?** The latest inspection charge on the service.

**Is the repeat inspection charged at the first-inspection fee?** No. A repeat inspection is charged at the tier's repeat PTI fee.

**Can an inspection be charged on a service that is already plugged in?** No. An inspection may be charged only while the service is PTI passed.
